gaps.description: Omits the dual-format distribution model, directory architecture, the skill domain list, agentskills.io compliance requirements, imported skills as submodules, and the docs/guide/ user guide.

States Cortex is 'for something similar' to surreal-memory, implying they serve the same purpose. In fact surreal-memory provides a knowledge graph, scoped memory, TaskStreams, Mindmaps, and palace RAG, while Cortex is a simpler project-scoped key-value memory.
gaps.corpus_ref: MISCONCEPTION: surreal-memory and Cortex are the same system

Explanation reproduces the known misconception that surreal-memory and Cortex are the same kind of system.
